Trash Dash

A little raccoon. A big adventure.

A glimpse into our world · Development artwork

Good friends.
Strange trouble.
One brave little raccoon.

In development · Launching in 2026

2D side-scrolling adventure

Planned for Steam, the App Store, and Google Play.

Home is worth a little trouble.

When the purple-black Gunk begins corrupting the animals around Trashy’s forest home, he and his best friend Jimothy follow the trail beyond the woods to help the creatures caught in it.

From forest to suburbia to city, their journey is about curiosity, friendship, and finding the courage to care. The infected animals are victims to help, not disposable enemies.

Expect expressive characters, a mischievous sense of humor, and little details that make the world feel personal.
